The cobbler is tied only to Top Hat, not to the last meal, so the novel point does not make it wrong. Last meal (meatloaf, mash, gravy, okra, cornbread) from TV Tropes as the writer had it. vibe.verdict: A true death row canteen with the real last meal, Wild Bill's corn bread and the faded lime floor, only short a few big heart moments.
